title: UBUSHINJACYAHA v. MUNYANKUSI N’ABANDI
text:
UBUSHINJACYAHA v. MUNYANKUSI N’ABANDI
[Rwanda URUKIKO RW’UBUJURIRE – RPAA00306/2024/CA (Kaliwabo, J. P.) 29 Mutarama
2026]
Amategeko agenga imanza nshinjabyaha – Impamvu nyoroshyacyaha – Kwemera icyaha – Kwemera
icyaha gushobora gufatwa nk’impamvu nyoroshyacyaha yashingirwaho ushinjwa agabanyirizwa
ibihano ari ugukozwe bitarenze mu iburanisha ku rwego rwa mbere, iyo ushinjwa yireze akemera
icyaha mu buryo budashidikanywa.
Amategeko agenga imanza nshinjabyaha – Ubujurire – Igabanyagihano mu rwego rw’ubujurire – Mu
rwego rwo guhuza igihano n’uburemere bw’icyaha, ntakibuza umucamanza wo ku rwego
rw’ubujurire kugabanyiriza igihano uwajuriye, mu gihe cyose asanga icyo yahawe ku rwego rwa
mbere kiremereye ugereranyije n’imikorere y’icyaha, kabone n’iyo ku rwego rubanza yaba
yaragabanyirijwe.
Incamake y’ikibazo: Munyankusi, Hakizimana na Nzaramba bategeye mu nzira Nsengumukiza
Salomon baramukubita bimuviramo gupfa, nyuma y’uko bamugurishije ibyuma bishaje ku mafaranga
4500, ntiyabasha kuyabishyura. Aba bose barafashwe barakurikiranwa, Ubushinjacyaha bubarega mu
Rukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Gasabo bubashinja icyaha cyo gukubita no gukomeretsa byamuvuyemo
urupfu. Abaregwa baburanye bahakana icyaha bavuga ko barengana, basaba kurenganurwa ngo kuko
nta cyaha bakoze.
Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwaciye urubanza rushingiye ku bimenyetso bitandukanye, rwemeza ko
Abaregwa bahamwa n’icyaha cyo gukubita no gukomeretsa byateye urupfu, rubahanisha igifungo
cy’imyaka makumyabiri (20) n’ihazabu y’amafaranga 7.000.000 kuri buri wese.
Abaregwa bajuririye mu Rukiko Rukuru basaba imbabazi ko babeshye Urukiko Rwisumbuye, kuri
ubu bakaba basaba imbabazi babikuye ku mutima wicujije kandi wanze icyaha no kwiyemeza
kutazongera kugwa mu byaha bakoze, dore ko bwari n’ubwa mbere baguye mu cyaha baregwa.
Ubushinjacyaha bwo buvuga ko izo mpamvu z’ubujurire z’Abaregwa nta shingiro zifite kuko baruhije
ubutabera bahakana icyaha mu nzego z’iperereza ndetse no mu Rukiko Rwisumbuye.
Urukiko Rukuru rwasanze ubujurire bw’Abaregwa nta shingiro bufite, kuko nta nenge bagaragaza
ikwiye gukosorwa mu rubanza bajuririra kandi aribyo bagombye kugaragaza, bityo rwemeza ko
imikirize y’urubanza bajuririye idahindutse mu ngingo zarwo zose.
Abaregwa bongeye kujuririra muri uru Rukiko rw’Ubujurire banenga urubanza rujuririrwa ko
rwabahanishije igihano kiremereye kandi baraburanye bemera icyaha ku buryo budashidikanywaho
banagisabira imbabazi, basaba kugabanyirizwa igihano kugeza mu nsi y’igito giteganyirizwa icyaha
bakoze, kuko aribwo bwa mbere bari baguye mu cyaha kandi bakaba bararangije kugororoka bihagije.
Muri uru rubanza, Ubushinjacyaha buvuga ko impamvu Abaregwa bashingiyeho bajurira zifite
ishingiro ku bijyanye no kugabanyirizwa ibihano, bubasabira ko ibihano bahawe byagabanywa
bikajya ku gifungo cy’imyaka itanu (5) n’ihazabu y’amafaranga 1.500.000, kuko mu gihe urubanza
rwabo rwari rutaraba ndakuka, Itegeko ryahinduye imihanire y’icyaha bashinjwa.
Incamake y’icyemezo: 1. Kwemera icyaha gushobora gufatwa nk’impamvu nyoroshyacyaha
yashingirwaho ushinjwa agabanyirizwa ibihano ari ugukozwe bitarenze mu iburanisha ku rwego rwa
mbere, iyo ushinjwa yireze akemera icyaha mu buryo budashidikanywa.
2. Mu rwego rwo guhuza igihano n’uburemere bw’icyaha, ntakibuza umucamanza wo ku rwego
rw’ubujurire kugabanyiriza igihano uwajuriye, mu gihe cyose asanga icyo yahawe ku rwego rwa

mbere kiremereye ugereranyije n’imikorere y’icyaha, kabone n’iyo ku rwego rubanza yaba
yaragabanyirijwe.
Ubujurire bufite ishingiro kuri bimwe.
Amategeko yashingiweho:
Itegeko Nº 059/2023 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023 rihindura kandi ryuzuza Itegeko Nº 68/2018 ryo ku wa
30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, ingingo ya 2 n’iya 11.
Itegeko Nº 027/2019 ryo ku wa 19/09/2019 ryerekeye imiburanishirize y’imanza z’inshinjabyaha,
ingingo ya 183.
Itegeko Nº 68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, ingingo ya 49,
59 n’iya 121.
Imanza zifashishijwe:
RPAA 00127/2023/CA, Ubushinjacyaha v. Sikubwabo Alphonse, Muvunyi Pascal, Maniragaba
Joseph na Nshimiyimana Phénéas, rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa 30/10/2025.
RPAA00442/2022/CA, Ubushinjacyaha v. Habumugisha Daniel rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku
wa 24/11/2023.
RPAA00048/2020/CA, Ubushinjacyaha v. Bimenyimana, rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa
26/05/2022.
RPAA00406/2020/CA, Ubushinjacyaha na Nahayo Ignace rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa
22/10/2021.
Urubanza
I. IMITERERE Y’URUBANZA
[1] Abitwa Hakizimana Gérard, Munyankusi Alexis (alias Mahinja) na Nzaramba Richard
bivugwa ko bagurishije Nsengumukiza Salomon ibyuma bishaje ku mafaranga 4500 ariko
ntiyashobora kwishyura bituma mw'ijoro ryo ku wa 17-18/10/2019 bamutegera mu nzira, basanga ari
kumwe n’uwitwa Dusenge Samuel uyu bamukubita inshyi mu matwi ariruka arabasiga, basigarana
Nsengumukiza Salomon baramukubita bimuviramo gupfa. Bamaze gufatwa bashyikirijwe
Ubugenzacyaha batangira gukurikiranwa.
[2] Nyuma y’iperereza, Ubushinjacyaha bwareze Hakizimana Gérard, Munyankusi Alexis
(Mahinja) na Nzaramba Richard mu Rukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Gasabo bubashinja icyaha cyo gukubita
no gukomeretsa Nsengumukiza Salomon byamuviriyemo urupfu. Baburanye bahakana icyaha bavuga
ko barengana kuko nta cyaha bakoze, basaba kurenganurwa.
[3] Mu rubanza RP01560/2019/TGI/GSBO rwaciwe ku wa 26/11/2020, Urukiko Rwisumbuye
rwa Gasabo, rushingiye ku bimenyetso byatanzwe n’Ubushinjacyaha birimo ubuhamya bwa
Usengimana Samuel na Musasangohe Mélanie babashinja no kuri raporo ya muganga igaragaza ko
Nsengumukiza Salomon yazize ibikomere byinshi yari afite ku mubiri, rwahamije Hakizimana Gérard,
Munyankusi Alexis (Mahinja) na Nzaramba Richard icyaha cyo gukubita no gukomeretsa byateye
urupfu, rubahanisha igifungo cy’imyaka makumyabiri (20ans) n’ihazabu y’amafaranga 7.000.000 kuri
buri wese.
[4] Hakizimana Gérard, Munyankusi Alexis na Nzaramba Richard bajuririye Urukiko Rukuru
bavuga ko bagamije gusaba imbabazi kuko bicuza icyaha bakoze cyo gukubita Nsengumukiza
Salomon bikamuviramo gupfa, bakaba baramukubise bamuziza ko atabishyuye amafaranga y’ibyuma

bamugurishije, basaba imbabazi ko babeshye Urukiko Rwisumbuye, kuri ubu bakaba basaba imbabazi
babikuye ku mutima wicujije kandi wanze icyaha no kwiyemeza kutazongera kugwa mu byaha bakoze
dore ko bwari n’ubwa mbere baguye muri kiriya cyaha.
[5] Ubushinjacyaha bwasubije buvuga ko impamvu zabo z’ubujurire nta shingiro zifite kuko
baruhije ubutabera bahakana icyaha mu nzego z’iperereza ndetse no mu Rukiko Rwisumbuye, kandi
hakaba hari umurongo watanzwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire, aho hemejwe ko kwemera icyaha bwa
mbere mu bujurire bitaba impamvu nyoroshyacyaha yagirira akamaro uregwa, busaba ko
hahamishwaho imikirize y’urubanza bajuririye mu ngingo zarwo zose.
[6] Mu rubanza RPA00138 /2021/HC/KIG rwaciwe kuwa 18/04/2024, Urukiko Rukuru rwasanze
ubujurire bwa Hakizimana Gérard, Munyankusi Alexis (Mahinja) na Nzaramba Richard nta shingiro
bufite kuko nta nenge bagaragaza ikwiye gukosorwa mu rubanza bajuririra kandi aribyo bagombye
kugaragaza nk’uko babisabwa mu ngingo ya 183 agace ka 5 na 6 y’ Itegeko Nº 027/2019 ryo ku wa
19/09/2019 ryerekeye imiburanishirize y’imanza z’inshinjabyaha. Urukiko rwemeje ko imikirize
y’urubanza bajuririye idahindutse mu ngingo zarwo zose, rubahamisha ku gifungo cy’imyaka
makumyabiri (20years) n’ihazabu y’amafaranga miliyoni zirindwi (7.000.000Frws) bahanishijwe
n’Urukiko Rwisumbuye.
[7] Hakizimana Gérard, Munyankusi Alexis (Mahinja) na Nzaramba Richard bajuririye Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire, Urubanza ruhabwa RPAA00306/2024/CA, iburanisha ribera mu ruhame kuwa
7/1/2026, Hakizimana Gérard yunganiwe na Me Ruganza Bin Seba, Munyankusi Alexis yunganiwe
na Me Florienne Nsabimana, Nzaramba Richard yunganiwe na Me Dative Uwizeyimana naho
Ubushinjacyaha buhagarariwe na Uwizeye Jean Marie, Umushinjacyaha ku rwego rw’Igihugu.
[8] Mu mwanzuro w’ubujurire Hakizimana Gérard, Munyankusi Alexis (Mahinja) na Nzaramba
Richard bajuriye banenga urubanza rujuririrwa ko rwabahanishije igihano kiremereye kandi
baraburanye bemera icyaha ku buryo budashidikanywaho banagisabira imbabazi, basaba
kugabanyirizwa igihano kugeza mu nsi y’igito giteganyirizwa icyaha bakoze kuko aribwo bwa mbere
bari baguye mu cyaha kandi bakaba bararangije kugororoka bihagije.
[9] Ubushinjacyaha bwasubije buvuga ko impamvu abaregwa bashingiyeho bajurira zifite
ishingiro ku bijyanye no kugabanyirizwa ibihano hashingiwe ku ngingo ya 11 y’Itegeko Nº 059/2023
ryo kuwa 04/12/2023 rihindura Itegeko N°68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano
muri rusange. Busaba ko ibihano abaregwa bahawe byo gufungwa imyaka makumyabiri (20 ans)
n’ihazabu y’amafaranga miliyoni zirindwi (7.000.000Frws) byagabanywa bikajya ku gifungo
cy’imyaka itanu (5ans) n’ihazabu y’amafaranga 1.500.000.
[10] Urukiko rurasuzuma niba igihano Hakizimana Gérard, Munyankusi Alexis (Mahinja) na
Nzaramba Richard bahanishijwe gikurikije amategeko, niba Urukiko Rukuru rwarakoze ikosa ryo
kudaha agaciro ingingo yo kwemera icyaha abashinjwa bakoreye mu bujurire no gusuzuma ubusabe
bw’abashinjwa bwo kugabanyirizwa ibihano.
II. ISESENGURA RY’IKIBAZO KIGIZE URUBANZA
Kumenya niba Hakizimana Gérard, Munyankusi Alexis (Mahinja) na Nzaramba Richard
barahanishijwe ibihano biremereye ku buryo byakongera kugabanywa
[11] Hakizimana Gérard, Munyankusi Alexis (Mahinja) na Nzaramba Richard bajuririye Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire banenga urubanza rujuririrwa ko rwabahanishije igihano kiremereye kandi baraburanye
bemera icyaha ku buryo budashidikanywaho banagisabira imbabazi. Basaba kugabanyirizwa igihano
kugeza ku gifungo cy’imyaka itanu (5 ans) kubera ko bakomeje kwemera icyaha no kugisabira

imbabazi, kuba ari ubwa mbere baguye mu cyaha no kuba bararangije kugororoka ku buryo
batazasubira kwishora mu cyaha ukundi.
[12] Me Ruganza Bin Seba wunganira Hakizimana Gérard, Me Florienne Nsabimana wunganira
Munyankusi Alexis na Me Dative Uwizeyimana wunganira Nzaramba Richard, bose bahuriza ku
ngingo imwe isaba ko abo bunganira bagabanyirizwa ibihano kuko baburanye bemera icyaha, kandi
aribwo bwa mbere baguye mu cyaha, basaba ko abashinjwa bagabanyirizwa ibihano kugera ku
gifungo cy’imyaka 5 n’ihazabu y’amafaranga 1,500,000 kuri buri wese, hashingiwe ku ngingo ya 2
(b) n’iya 11 z’Itegeko Nº 059/2023 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023 rihindura Itegeko Nº 68/2018 ryo ku wa
30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange.
[13] Uhagarariye Ubushinjacyaha uvuga ko impamvu abaregwa bashingiyeho bajurira zifite
ishingiro ku bijyanye no kugabanyirizwa ibihano kuko mu gihe urubanza rwabo rutari rwakabaye
ndakuka, Itegeko ryahinduye imihanire y’icyaha bashinjwa, bityo ko hashingiwe ku ngingo ya 2 (b)
n’iya 11 z’Itegeko Nº 059/2023 ryo kuwa 04/12/2023 rihindura itegeko N°68/2018 ryo ku wa
30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, bahanishwa igifungo cy’ imyaka 5 n’ihazabu
y’amafaranga 1.500.000 kuri buri wese, ibi bikaba bisobanurwa no kuba ari ubwa mbere baguye mu
cyaha.
[14] Akomeza avuga ko iryo gabanyagihano ryaba rikurikije umurongo watanzwe mu zindi manza
zisa n’uru nk’urubanza RPAA00442/2022/CA rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa 24/11/2023,
Ubushinjacyaha buburana na Habumugisha Daniel aho rwavuze ko nta cyabuza urukiko kugabanyiriza
igihano uregwa hagamijwe gutanga igihano gihwanye n’uburemere bw’icyaha burebewe hamwe no
kuba uregwa aburana yemera icyaha, kandi ari ubwa mbere akurikiranwe mu butabera ku buryo buzwi.
UKO URUKIKO RUBIBONA
A. Kumenya niba abashinjwa barahanishijwe ibihano bikurikije amategeko
[15] Mu gihe abashinjwa bakoraga icyaha n’igihe baciriwe urubanza ku rwego rwa mbere, icyaha
cyo gukubita no gukomeretsa byateye urupfu cyari giteganyijwe mu ngingo ya 121 y’Itegeko Nº
68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, iyi ngingo ikaba
yarateganyirizaga uhamwe n’icyaha cyo gukubita no gukomeretsa byateye urupfu, igihano
cy’igifungo kitari munsi y’imyaka 15 ariko kitarenze imyaka 20 n’ihazabu itari munsi y’amafaranga
5.000.000 ariko itarenze amafaranga 7.000.000.
[16] Urukiko rurasanga, mu gihe urubanza RPA00138/2021/HC/KIG rwacibwaga n’Urukiko
Rukuru ku wa 18/04/2024, ingingo ya 121 y’Itegeko Nº 68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 ryavuzwe
haruguru, yari yamaze guhindurwa n’ingingo ya 11 y’Itegeko Nº 059/2018 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023,
icyaha cyo gukubita no gukomeretsa kikaba gihanishwa igihano cy’igifungo kitari munsi y’imyaka 10
ariko kitarenze imyaka 20 n’ihazabu itari munsi y’amafaranga 3.000.000 ariko itarenze amafaranga
5.000.000.
[17] Urukiko rurasanga, Urukiko Rukuru rwaragombaga guhana abashinjwa muri uru rubanza
hashingiwe ku biteganywa mu ngingo ya 11 y’Itegeko Nº 059/2018 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023, bityo kuba
rwarabahanishije igifungo cy’imyaka 20 n’ihazabu ya 7.000.000Frw, rukaba rwarabahanishije
ihazabu idateganyirijwe icyaha bahamijwe kuko itagombaga kurenga amafaranga 5.000.000, iri kosa
rikaba rigomba gukosorwa kuri uru rwego.
B. Kumenya niba Urukiko rwarakoze ikosa ryo kudaha agaciro ingingo y’abashinjwa
bemeye icyaha bwa mbere mu rwego rw’Ubujurire

[18] Ikibazo cyo kumenya agaciro gahabwa ingingo yo kwemera icyaha bwa mbere mu bujurire
cyahawe umurongo mu rubanza RPAA00048/2020/CA rwaciwe ku wa 26/05/2022 aho Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire rwemeje ko, kwemera icyaha gushobora gufatwa nk’impamvu nyoroshyacyaha
yashingirwaho ushinjwa agabanyirizwa ibihano ari ugukozwe bitarenze mu iburanisha ku rwego rwa
mbere, iyo ushinjwa yireze akemera icyaha mu buryo budashidikanywa. Ibi Urukiko rukaba
rwarabyemeje rushingiye ku biteganywa mu ngingo ya 59, agace ka 3 y’Itegeko Nº 68/2018 ryo ku
wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, nk’uko ryahinduwe kugeza ubu.
[19] Urukiko rurasanga, kuba ku rwego rwa mbere abashinjwa barahisemo kuburana bahakana
icyaha baregwa, bakacyemera bwa mbere mu bujurire, iyi ntiyaba ingingo bashingiraho basaba
kugabanyirizwa ibihano, Urukiko Rukuru rukaba nta kosa rwakoze kuko rwubahirije umurongo
wavuzwe mu gika kibanziriza iki.
C. Ku birebana n’ubusabe bw’abashinjwa bwo kugabanyirizwa ibihano hashingiwe ko ari
ubwa mbere baguye mu cyaha
[20] Ku birebana n’ingingo yo kugabanyirizwa ibihano ku rwego rw’ubujurire, Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire rwabitanzeho umurongo mu rubanza RPAA00406/2020/CA rwaciwe n’Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire ku wa 22/10/2021, haburana Ubushinjacyaha na Nahayo Ignace, aho rwemeje ko
ntakibuza umucamanza wo ku rwego rw’ubujurire kugabanyiriza igihano uwajuriye, mu gihe cyose
asanga icyo yahawe ku rwego rwa mbere kiremereye ugereranyije n’imikorere y’icyaha, kabone n’iyo
ku rwego rubanza yaba yaragabanyirijwe; ibi bikaba ari mu rwego rwo guhuza igihano n’uburemere
bw’icyaha (Principe de la proportionnalité de la peine à l’infraction), ibi kandi bikaba bihuza
n’ibivugwa mu ngingo ya 49 y’Itegeko N° 68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano
muri rusange.
[21] Ingingo ya 11 y’Itegeko Nº 059/2023 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023 rihindura Itegeko Nº 68/2018 ryo
ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, iteganya ko ingingo ya 121 y’Itegeko Nº
68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange ihinduwe ku buryo bukurikira:
(6) iyo gukubita cyangwa gukomeretsa byateye urupfu, igihano kiba igifungo kitari munsi y’imyaka
10 ariko kitarenze imyaka 20 n’ihazabu itari munsi ya 3.000.000Frw ariko itarenze 5.000.000Frw.
[22] Ku byerekeye uru rubanza, Urukiko rurasanga, mu kugena ibihano, Urukiko rwaragombye
kureba impamvu zongera ububi bw’icyaha zigizwe no kuba abashinjwa barakoze icyaha cyagize
ingaruka yo kwambura ubuzima Nsengumukiza Salomon wari ukiri umusore, kuba barakoze icyaha
babitegeye igico no kuba barakoze icyaha ari agatsiko k’abantu barenze umuntu 1. Nyamara kandi,
kuba ari ubwa mbere abashinjwa baguye mu cyaha ku buryo buzwi, byari gutuma Urukiko Rukuru
rubagabanyiriza ibihano aho kubahanisha ibihano bihanitse ntarengwa (maximum de la peine)
biteganyirizwa icyaha bahamijwe, bityo kuri uru rwego, bakaba bagomba kubigabanyirizwa.
[23] Urukiko rurasanga, ubusabe bwa Hakizimana Gérard, Munyankusi Alexis (Mahinja) na
Nzaramba Richard bwo guhanishwa ibihano bito ntarengwa (le minimum de la peine) biteganyirizwa
icyaha bashinjwa, budashobora guhabwa agaciro kabone nubwo babyemeranywaho
n’Ubushinjacyaha, kuko byaba ari ukwirengagiza impamvu zongera ububi bw’icyaha zarondowe mu
gika kibanziriza iki.
[24] Urukiko rurasanga abashinjwa, nk’uko bavuzwe haruguru, n’ubwunganizi bwabo bavuga ko
bagabanyirizwa igihano kugera ku gifungo cy’imyaka itanu(5ans) n’ihazabu ya 1,500,000Frws
hashingiwe ku ngingo ya 2 (b) na 11 z’Itegeko Nº 059/2023 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023 rihindura itegeko
Nº 68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange ndetse bakabivugaho
rumwe n’ubushinjacyaha nta shingiro byahabwa kuko kuba barakubise Nsengumukiza Salomon

babanje gutega igico kandi ari agatsiko k’abantu barenze umwe, ari impamvu igaragaza ubugome
bukomeye bakoranye icyaha ikaba yongera kandi n’ububi bwacyo.
[25] Urukiko rw’ubujurire rurusanga, rushingiye ku ngingo 11 y’Itegeko Nº 059/2023 ryo ku wa
04/12/2023 ryavuzwe haruguru, rushingiye kandi ku bisobanuro birebana n’impamvu zongera ububi
bw’icyaha n’impamvu nyoroshyacyaha irebana nuko abashinjwa aribwo bwa mbere baguye mu cyaha,
rurasanga Hakizimana Gérard, Munyankusi Alexis (Mahinja) na Nzaramba Richard bakwiye
kugabanyirizwa ibihano bahawe, bagahanishwa igifungo cy’imyaka cumi n’itanu (15ans) no gutanga
ihaza y’amafaranga miliyoni eshatu (3.000.000Frw) kuri buri wese, kuko aribyo bihano bikwiranye
n’uburemere bw’icyaha bakoze cyo gukubita Nsengumukiza Salomon bikamuviramo urupfu.
[26] Urukiko rurasanga ibihano abashinjwa bahanishijwe ari nabyo byahanishijwe abandi bantu
bakoze icyaha mu buryo bumwe, ibi bikaba biboneka mu manza zitandukanye zaciwe n’uru Rukiko,
rumwe mu ziheruka akaba ari urubanza RPAA00127/2023/CA rwaciwe ku wa 30/10/2025 haburana
ubushinjacyaha na Sikubwabo Alphonse, Muvunyi Pascal, Maniragaba Joseph na Nshimiyimana
Phénéas.
III. ICYEMEZO CY’URUKIKO
[27] Rwemeje ko ubujurire bwatanzwe na Hakizimana Gérard, Munyankusi Alexis (Mahinja) na
Nzaramba Richard bufite ishingiro ku bijyanye no kugabanyirizwa ibihano.
[28] Rwemeje ko imikirize y’urubanza RPA00138/2021/HC/KIG rwaciwe n’Urukiko Rukuru
